title: SEED-L01 active loan-status ordinal read-back
_note: Parity vector transcribing the active loan-status read-back of the SEED-L01 loan detail. request.status.stored_value=300 is the capture status block's "id":300, the persisted m_loan.loan_status_id; expect.status_code="loanStatusType.active" is that block's "code"; expect.status_stored_value=300 is the stored value the decoded enum must round-trip to — Fineract stores ACTIVE as 300, not as the contiguous iota ordinal 3. Nothing was computed by this promotion.

provenance.note: request.status.stored_value and expect.status_code/status_stored_value are transcribed from the status block of the committed capture loan-1-detail-raw.json; capture_case_id names the externalId of the observed loan.
